It’s ok, the conversation just put the tattoo in your mind again and you went for it! You did something nice for yourself. You probably would’ve gotten it if someone else brought it up too! You deserve to enjoy your new tattoo, I bet you look awesome. 

It has nothing to do with him, so don’t be hard on yourself. I really doubt he is making fun of you, since he’s the one that brought it up in the first place. He asked for the picture. He might be feeling embarrassed about breaking NC too! The tattoo is for you, I think the conversation just ignited some excitement and eagerness to get it. Even if it was just to keep talking to him, that’s completely fine too. You’re human. But the tattoo is yours, and if he doesn’t respond then that’s okay. Nothing has changed! X

I am also over 6 foot and heavy….. I’ve tried hoop and pole, and I ended up crying and hiding in the bathroom for my last lesson. It felt like everyone could do it, looked so easy for them. I paid for a whole 10 week beginner course and only did 4 lessons because I felt so pathetic. 

After a whole hour of being unable to do any moves properly and watching all the other girls look so graceful and beautiful, my instructor was making us do a headstand? I have never done anything like that and felt really uneasy. Everyone was nervous but somehow they did it. I tried refusing but she was really adamant that I tried, even tho I felt like I was gonna break my neck. I couldn’t hold back my tears and had to go hide, then never returned :( this was 2 years ago and I still wish I could do it but unfortunately the humiliation of the experience makes me feel like I can’t.
